ratingRequest.title: Rating Request JSON
ratingRequest.description: JSON representing the rating request which contains information to create a shipment, including sender, recipient, package details, and other optional information. You can provide either a Salesforce Record ID or a Rating Request JSON.

recordId.title: Salesforce Record ID
recordId.description: Salesforce Record ID of the record from which you want to create a shipping label. The system will automatically populate the Shipping Wizard based on the mapping configured in Custom Metadata.
